ambiguity: You asked for the plan limits to be applied without saying what passing one does: refuse the request, or let it through.

facts.fact: The limits are soft, so going over is still permitted and we bill the excess afterwards. The free plan is the one exception: it refuses once usage passes 110 percent of its limit.
We are not fussy about rounding.
An unrecognised plan name will never reach this function.

stonewall: No strong view on that one - use your judgement.
